description:
Configure three global environment variables in Jenkins system settings, then create and run a freestyle job to verify they propagate correctly.

1. Navigate to Manage Jenkins > System (Configure System).
2. Under 'Global properties', enable the 'Environment variables' checkbox.
3. Add these environment variables:
   - Name: DEPLOY_TARGET, Value: staging-cluster-01
   - Name: API_BASE_URL, Value: https://api.example.com/v2
   - Name: BUILD_RETENTION_DAYS, Value: 30
4. Save the system configuration.
5. Create a new Freestyle project named exactly 'EnvVar-Verification-Job'.
6. Add an 'Execute shell' build step with the command:
   echo "DEPLOY_TARGET=$DEPLOY_TARGET"
   echo "API_BASE_URL=$API_BASE_URL"
   echo "BUILD_RETENTION_DAYS=$BUILD_RETENTION_DAYS"
7. Save the job and click 'Build Now'.
8. Wait for the build to complete successfully.
